purpose: Field dictionary and decision rules for interpreting XAUUSD 1H evidence from the TradingView webhook lane and the local_computation lane. All encodings are derived from the Pine SSOT sources with line references; nothing here is inferred from field names.

input_lanes.tradingview_webhook: Indicator outputs computed by TradingView on the closed 1H candle. Three webhook sources: prophet_r38 (The Prophet v7.02 R38 indicator), prophet_r37_ssot (the shared Prophet structure core computed inside GMI from MizanLib) and gmi_v12_70 (Global Multiverse Interceptor v12.70). Ground truth for the indicator state.
input_lanes.local_computation: Recomputed locally from raw TradingView OHLCV by three local engines: MizanLib (record engine id 'mizan'), Prophet (engine id 'prophet') and GMI (engine id 'gmi'). Only trust local values whose trust_status is approved_by_parity (24 consecutive candles matched the webhook field by field). values.diagnostics are unverified internals: use them only to explain, never as decisive evidence.

local_engines.MizanLib: engine id 'mizan'. Shared library core (prophet_structure_core, calculate_prophet_tensor) used by both Prophet and GMI. It has no webhook of its own; it is trusted only while an approved Prophet and an approved GMI both declare this MizanLib identity as their dependency.
local_engines.Prophet: engine id 'prophet'. values.comparable.prophet_r38 is compared with the prophet_r38 webhook and values.comparable.prophet_r37_ssot with the prophet_r37_ssot webhook.
local_engines.GMI: engine id 'gmi'. values.comparable.gmi_v12_70 is compared with the gmi_v12_70 webhook.

input_lanes.naming_rule: Local engines are named MizanLib, Prophet and GMI. prophet_r38, prophet_r37_ssot and gmi_v12_70 are WEBHOOK source names (and the keys of values.comparable), not local engine names.
input_lanes.fundamental_news: Completed news analysis (analyst, counselor, reasoner) of articles from the last hour. Context only; it never creates a technical trigger by itself.
lane_rules: Never merge, average or relabel values across lanes; attribute every claim to its lane.
If webhook and approved local values disagree for the same field, report the disagreement and prefer WAIT.
structure_state and shared_core_status are chart-relative bar_index values (may be NaN/null). They carry no direction; ignore them.

prophet_r38.description: The Prophet v7.02 R38 on the 1H chart, V2 (non-legacy) gate. Emitted once per closed bar.

values.0: no new confirmation on this bar

direction.note: A one-bar EVENT, not a persistent bias. 0 on most bars is normal and means 'no new signal', not bearish or neutral bias.

buy_confirmed.meaning: True only on the first bar that passes the V2 buy gate after a raw buy cross.
gate: Raw buy cross: pro_fast crosses above pro_slow while pro_fast < -0.15 (deep oversold), on a confirmed bar.
Within the confirmation window (3 bars on 1H) and not superseded by a later sell cross.
Bullish price confirmation: close > open and close > previous high.
Fresh bullish structure (event within 6 bars): d_enc == 1, or b_enc == 3 with d_enc != 0, or d_enc == -3 with subtype 3 (bear trap) or 2 (true breakout).
Volume: no volume data, or signal volume ratio >= 0.85.

sell_confirmed.meaning: Mirror of buy_confirmed: raw cross below with pro_fast > 0.15, bearish price confirmation (close < open and close < previous low), fresh bearish structure (d_enc == -1, or b_enc == -3 with d_enc != 0, or d_enc == 3 with subtype 1 or 4), volume ratio >= 0.85.

buy_high_quality.meaning: buy_confirmed AND real volume with signal ratio >= 1.0 AND the KWW z-score (50) reached <= -0.618 during the setup window (depth). Stronger than buy_confirmed alone.

t_enc.meaning: Trade-management state of an EXISTING position (not an entry signal). Non-legacy precedence: d_enc==3 first, then price discovery, then the rest.

values.1: PYRAMID BULL: add to longs (bullish structure state d_enc==-3, or strong bullish cycle alignment with efficiency > 0.5, volume anomaly >= 0.85 and Hurst > 0.60)
values.3: REVERSAL: b_enc is +/-3 and the market is NOT strongly trending (Hurst <= 0.60)
values.4: RUTHLESS CUT LOSS: bearish structure state d_enc==3 without a strong macro filter. The only t_enc that acts as a veto for longs
values.5: AWAIT MACRO (HOLD): d_enc==3 but strong trend (Hurst > 0.60) and |z-score| >= 1.0. Not a veto (R37 FIX-1)
values.-1: PYRAMID BEAR: add to shorts (mirror of 1)
values.2|-2: TP (OVERBOUGHT/OVERSOLD): defined in the decoder but not assigned by R38

t_enc.management_direction: tm_dir = +1 for t_enc 1, -2, 6; -1 for t_enc -1, 2, 4, -6; 0 otherwise.

prophet_r37_ssot.description: Shared Prophet structure core as computed inside GMI v12.70 (MizanLib prophet_structure_core) on the same 1H bar.

direction.meaning: r10_prophet_consensus_dir: sign of pro_fast, combined with the structure direction (subtype 2/3 or d_enc 1 -> +1; subtype 1/4 or d_enc -1 -> -1). If the two disagree the result is 0 (internal conflict). Persistent state, unlike prophet_r38.direction.

bull_event.meaning: A bullish structure event (bullish divergence, bullish break, true breakout or bear trap) is on record since the last oscillator zero-cross. Not necessarily on this bar.

bear_event.meaning: Mirror of bull_event for bearish structure events.

structure_state.meaning: bar_index of the last trap/breakout resolution; chart-relative, ignore.

structure_core.description: MizanLib prophet_structure_core: divergence and structure state machine on the Prophet fast oscillator (pivots 5/2). States reset on an oscillator zero-cross and expire after state_max_age bars.

values.1: BULLISH DIVERGENCE: price made a lower low while the oscillator made a higher low below zero
values.3: BEARISH STRUCTURE STATE: resolved as subtype 1 (bull trap) or 4 (true breakdown)
values.-1: BEARISH DIVERGENCE: price made a higher high while the oscillator made a lower high above zero
values.-3: BULLISH STRUCTURE STATE: resolved as subtype 2 (true breakout) or 3 (bear trap / liquidity sweep down)

d_enc.warning: Sign convention is inverted for the resolved states: d_enc 3 is BEARISH and d_enc -3 is BULLISH.

values.3: bullish break: after a bullish divergence, close > previous high on a bullish candle; also set for true breakout / bear trap
values.-3: bearish break: after a bearish divergence, close < previous low on a bearish candle
values.-4: bearish resolved state (bull trap or true breakdown)

values.1: BULL TRAP / FAKEOUT UP: after a bearish divergence price closed above the prior high but with top rejection or weak volume (bearish)
values.2: TRUE BREAKOUT: after a bearish divergence price closed above the prior high with real volume and no rejection (bullish)
values.3: BEAR TRAP / LIQUIDITY SWEEP DOWN: after a bullish divergence price closed below the prior low but with bottom rejection or weak volume (bullish)
values.4: TRUE BREAKDOWN: after a bullish divergence price closed below the prior low with real volume and no rejection (bearish)

refs.contains: // subtype: 0 unresolved, 1 bull trap, 2 true breakout, 3 bear trap, 4 true breakdown.

gmi_v12_70.description: Global Multiverse Interceptor v12.70 action verdict after the override chain and the R10 Prophet x GMI x Volume-Profile confluence gate.

values.0: WAIT / no directional verdict: includes entropy trap (avalanche), volume veto (fakeout likely), chaos, and R10 conflict resets
values.4: EXTENSION STATE: review position risk (macro bullish and pro_fast > 0.45). Not an entry
values.-1: EXHAUSTION / RISK ALERT (macro bullish but kinetics decelerating). Not a short signal

derivation: Base state, first match wins: kinetic reversal long/short -> +/-3; ext_state 1 with bullish macro -> -1; ext_state 2 with bullish macro -> 4; bullish macro with bullish structure or flow -> 3; bearish macro with bearish structure or flow -> -3.

Overrides, first match wins: entropy trap -> 0; zone setup with volume veto -> 0; GABFX/whale/Aegis OB buy or sell -> +/-3; Fabio Model 1 (NY trend) -> +/-3; Fabio Model 2 (London fakeout) -> +/-3; JMA oversold/overbought inside value area -> +/-3; kinetic reversal -> +/-3.
R10 gate: if conflict, verdict is reset to 0.

values.0: integration inactive (disabled or bar not confirmed)
values.1: evaluable, no conflict, but not fully aligned (for example GMI neutral or price inside the value area)
values.2: ALIGNED: GMI direction == Prophet consensus == volume-profile location (close above VAH for long, below VAL for short). Strongest confluence
values.-1: CONFLICT: Prophet internal conflict, GMI vs Prophet, VP location vs Prophet, or Prophet risk hold (subtype 1 bull trap). Verdict forced to 0
values.-2: volume profile invalid; gate not evaluable

gmi_dir.meaning: Direction of the GMI verdict BEFORE the R10 reset (3 -> 1, -3 -> -1, else 0). With conflict=true you can see gmi_dir != 0 while verdict == 0.

conflict.meaning: r10_integration_conflict. True means GMI blocked the setup; treat as WAIT.

shared_core_status.meaning: bar_index of the shared structure state; chart-relative, may be NaN. Ignore.

chaos.meaning: entropy >= 0.8 or noise >= 0.85: safe mode, no directional trust.

volume_veto.meaning: 3-bar volume below 35% of its average: zone setups are vetoed as likely fakeouts.

kinetic_reversal.meaning: TVA kinetics estimate a reversal within <= 5 bars with price outside the value area.

volume_profile.meaning: VAH/VAL/POC from the TDM profile; r10_vp_location_dir = +1 above VAH, -1 below VAL, 0 inside.

decision_policy.basis: Project policy (Prophet = base bias, GMI = validator) applied to the Pine encodings above. Field meanings come from Pine; these combination rules are the project's, not TradingView's.
decision_policy.base_bias_source: prophet_r37_ssot.direction (persistent consensus). prophet_r38.direction/buy_confirmed/sell_confirmed are entry TRIGGER events, not bias.
decision_policy.gmi_role: validate, block or wait on Prophet setups; must not silently overwrite Prophet's bias
actionable_long_requires: prophet_r38.buy_confirmed == true on this candle (prefer buy_high_quality)
gmi_v12_70.conflict == false and gmi_v12_70.gate in {1, 2} (2 = full confluence)
actionable_short_requires: prophet_r38.sell_confirmed == true on this candle (prefer sell_high_quality)
always_wait_when: any required lane is missing or evidence fusion is incomplete
gmi_v12_70.verdict is 0 because of chaos, entropy trap or volume veto, and there is no confirmed Prophet trigger
webhook and approved local values disagree on a decisive field
risk_management_signals: t_enc 4 (RUTHLESS CUT LOSS) is the only management veto; t_enc 5 is a hold, not a veto
gmi verdict 4 (extension) and -1 (exhaustion) mean review risk on existing positions; they are not entries

analysis_requirements: Decode every numeric field with this field_dictionary before reasoning; quote the decoded meaning (for example 'd_enc -3 = bullish structure state').
Separate reported indicator values from model interpretation, and attribute each value to its lane.
State missing or conflicting evidence explicitly; never invent prices, levels or indicator states.
Entry, stop and target prices may only come from supplied candle OHLC values; otherwise leave them null and decide WAIT.
Give bullish, bearish and neutral scenarios when evidence is mixed.
limitations: Webhook payloads expose only the fields listed here; internal series (pro_fast values, z-scores, volume profile levels) are not in the webhook and must not be guessed.
Local engine diagnostics are unverified unless the engine identity is approved_by_parity, and even then only the compared fields are verified.
The assistant does not execute trades or connect to a broker.

news_policy.role: Fundamental context for gold, dollar and oil. It can raise or lower conviction and add risks, but never creates a BUY/SELL on its own.
rules: Use only the supplied articles from the last hour; cite titles.
If articles do not mention gold or its drivers (USD, real yields, Fed, inflation, geopolitics, safe-haven flows), say the evidence is weak.
Output a bias (BULLISH_BIAS, BEARISH_BIAS, NEUTRAL, WAIT_FOR_TECHNICAL_CONFIRMATION), never an entry.
